script.title: Imperial Star Destroyer: Pursuit of the Tantive IV
script.description: A wedge-hulled Imperial I-class Star Destroyer on a display stand, terraced hull, trench, ziggurat superstructure, bridge tower with shield domes, glowing engines; the Tantive IV flees ahead.
